title: Research Across Faith, Culture, and Product Decisions
subtitle: European Christian-product context, qualitative research, and evidence that changed what teams built

bio.short: I work where research has to carry culture into product decisions. At Bibel TV I combine German-language user research with product leadership for Bible and streaming experiences. Earlier research changed strategy at Spreadshirt and opened access to difficult-to-reach enterprise users at Datameer.
bio.long:
At Bibel TV I lead product design for a German Bible broadcaster's consumer products. Interviews, feature-use evidence and cultural interpretation shape the product direction. One concept survey reversed the redesign's initial dark-mode direction. Users described it as gloomy and asked for brightness and readability, so the product moved to a light-first system.

At Spreadshirt, in-person interviews with German shop owners challenged leadership's assumption that full automation was the right seller strategy. I then led and usability-tested a mobile T-shirt-designer research prototype; strong user feedback helped move it into production and shifted the company's mobile direction. At Datameer I secured research access to analysts inside US banks and insurers. I developed research protocols and used iterative UserTesting.com screening to reach participants ordinary panels could not supply.

My research operations combine Dovetail, Microsoft Teams transcription and careful AI-assisted synthesis. At Ninox, Dovetail held the shared research record while Claude helped analyze thousands of forum posts for sentiment, recurring pain points and feature requests. I use AI when volume makes the work otherwise impractical. For smaller studies I read the material directly because summaries can erase nuance and context. ChurchDesk adds product experience across Protestant and Catholic contexts in six European markets.

context.company: YouVersion develops Bible products used globally and is building European Hubs to make product and content experiences reflect local cultures and contexts.
context.role: Hands-on European UXR contractor conducting qualitative studies, maintaining the research repository, synthesizing evidence and helping a US-based research team translate cultural insight into product direction.
